name: 公開範囲と所有者を持つ保存済み表示の概要カード群
prompt:
Recreate the standalone Linear saved-view summary and visibility/owner cards shown in the primary original screenshot crop. Match the source crop's 494:224 aspect ratio (about 2.21:1), two stacked white rounded cards, outer boundaries, gap, padding, alignment, divider spacing, subtle borders/shadows and icon placement. Use the original screenshot for geometry, colors, identity, icon art and visible state; the Japanese mock supplies localized UI labels and title/description.

Top card: at left, the original small thumbs-up icon in its pale rounded square; beside it the title 「優先度の高い作業」 in dark semibold text. At the far right of that same line, preserve an outline star and a three-dot menu. Below the title show the muted description 「優先度を「高」にした課題」. Keep the source's compact card height and light-gray outline.

Second card: two compact rows. Row one has the muted label 「公開範囲」 at left, followed by the original workspace/building icon and the value 「共有領域」. Row two has the muted label 「所有者」, then the original small purple circular avatar with white AM initials, followed by the exact source owner email 「alexsmith.mobbin@gmail.com」 in dark text. The Japanese mock substitutes this email with the placeholder name 山田 花子; preserve the original source identity instead.

Use clean white surfaces, small neutral borders, source-matched typography and restrained gray icons. Keep the cards edge to edge and the text readable at the source crop's proportions. Do not add page background, issue rows, extra actions, status chips or any other content.
reviewNotes: Candidate aspect 2.2036:1 matches source 2.2054:1. Side-by-side comparison confirms both stacked cards, control placement and owner row. Japanese labels and title copy are used; source identity is preserved as purple AM avatar and alexsmith.mobbin@gmail.com.
